data.define: An idiom for very heavy rain.

misuse.text: Don't look for real animals when it's 'raining cats and dogs'.
misuse.why: It's an idiom for heavy rain.

native.tip: “raining cats and dogs” = hujan deras. Contoh: “It's raining cats and dogs!”
native.caption:
Apa arti “raining cats and dogs”?
“raining cats and dogs” = hujan deras.
Contoh: “It's raining cats and dogs!” ("It's raining cats and dogs"!)
